description: Before training anything on a table: give a CSV and the target column, and get what kind of problem it is (binary classification or regression), what is wrong with the data — class imbalance, constant columns, gaps, identifier columns, high-cardinality categories and LEAKS (a column that alone predicts the target) — and how four models (linear, decision tree, random forest, gradient boosting) score in k-fold cross-validation NEXT TO THE BASELINE (majority class or mean), with the fold-to-fold spread. It says plainly when no model beats the baseline. Prefer `path`: the data then never enters the conversation. Deterministic (seeded); nothing leaves the machine.

csv.description: The CSV pasted, if there is no file. Alternative to path

path.description: Path to the CSV file (header in the first line; separator , ; or tab). Alternative to csv

seed.description: Seed for the folds and the sample

target.description: Column to predict, exactly as in the header. Default: the last column

name: ml_triage
title: Triage a CSV for machine learning: task, data problems, models vs a baseline
